objective: 确定并实现通用 Workspace 到真实 DSH static Client 的最小浏览器分发与挂载缝，避免复制 renderer 或把 DSH 语义写回共享前端。

semantic_brief.summary: 真实 DSH 入口需要消费通用 Workspace UI，但 DSH classic client bundle 与当前 CommonJS shared source 之间没有分发缝；本项先锁定可替换的 bundle/bridge 形状，再实现实际挂载。
core_points: 共享前端 canonical source 只能有一份，DSH client 只能是打包/Host adapter，不得复制 renderer 语义。
挂载必须复用 ProductSession identity、DetailRef 和错误/快照 read model。
静态 Client 的 strict codec、remote mount、重启和 profile copy 行为必须纳入验收。

acceptance: 审计给出当前 DSH classic client、Host RPC、shared CommonJS source 的真实调用链和最小 bridge/bundle seam。
明确哪些文件需要实现、哪些现有 API 保持不变，以及如何证明 shared renderer 没有复制或反向依赖 DSH。
提供可执行的离线 bundle smoke、strict codec、Host mount 和重启后浏览器验收方法；若当前 package 结构不能安全实现，明确 UPSTREAM_DESIGN_CONFLICT，不伪造完成。
本项审计期间不修改 Product Runtime、旧 DSH API、shared renderer/core/schema 或现有 client 行为。
forbidden: 不得把 DSH sessionId 变成 shared ProductSession identity。
不得复制一份仅供 DSH 的 renderer、View Model 或错误归一化逻辑。
不得在没有 bundle/profile/restart 证据时宣称真实 DSH 挂载完成。
frozen_decisions: web/uniclaw-workspace 是通用前端 canonical source。
DSH static Client 只承担 UI bundle、RPC descriptor 和 Host mount。

current_call_chain: DSH web plugin table serves package exports ./client -> src/client.js
classic window.__ModuleLoader__.load registers apply/inject; apply injects sidebar.footer.action and shell.overlay
first workspace/session/artifact action calls remote.$mount(contribution), then remote.uniclawTaskPanel.{workspace,session,artifact}
the existing DSH panel service in src/index.js maps those RPCs to DSH repository/session/artifact data

createDshWorkspaceHost is a separate Node-side assembly: panel -> createDshWorkspaceCapabilities -> WorkspaceQueryCore -> createWorkspaceApp -> caller mount; it is not referenced by src/client.js and cannot be called from the browser bundle
feasibility_boundary: The host-neutral QueryCore/App/Controller/ViewModel/HTML renderer are CommonJS and can be consumed by Node Host wrappers through createRequire.

The current classic client cannot directly consume those CommonJS modules: it has no bundler/module-loader bridge for web/uniclaw-workspace and the existing client embeds a second React renderer/state/RPC projection.

The current client strict codec helper puts parse under create(); the static-client skill requires strict codec schema.parse. This requires a focused descriptor/client seam correction before real DSH verification.
Therefore the current source is not evidence of shared renderer reuse or a complete browser bridge; implementation must stop at this audit.

recommended_seam.bundle: Add a browser-targeted, generated-or-explicit client bridge entry under the DSH package that imports a browser-compatible shared UI facade (renderer/ViewModel/controller facade) and emits the classic ModuleLoader factory. Keep it as an adapter/bundle layer; do not copy renderer semantics into client.js.
recommended_seam.rpc: Keep DSH static client responsible for remote.$mount descriptors and strict codecs only. The Host side owns the panel service and maps ProductSessionId through the explicit resolver; DSH sessionId remains hostSessionRef.
recommended_seam.shared: Keep web/uniclaw-workspace/src/core, features, ui, styles as canonical source. If CommonJS cannot be bundled safely, introduce a source-level browser build entry or package export with identical contracts, then prove parity; do not make the browser load Node createRequire.

files_to_add_or_change: dsh/uniclaw-task-workbench/src/client-bridge.js (or an equivalent explicit browser bundle source)
dsh/uniclaw-task-workbench/src/client.js (thin generated/static loader output only, after bridge contract is frozen)
web/uniclaw-workspace/package.json and a browser-compatible export only if the chosen bundling seam requires it
do_not_change: DSH HTTP/RPC service semantics and existing workspace/session/artifact API names
canonical shared renderer/ViewModel/core semantics except through an explicit, tested browser export
create-workspace-host.js unless its public adapter contract needs a separately reviewed mount bridge

verification.offline_bundle_smoke: Evaluate the static bundle with a fake window.__ModuleLoader__ and fake require('react'), assert loader id, exports.apply/inject, and no Node globals; separately execute the bridge against a fake mount.
verification.strict_codec: Capture remote.$mount contribution and assert every parameter/result codec has mode strict, typeSymbol, and schema.parse; reject create-only codec shapes.
verification.host_mount: Use the existing fake panel plus resolver to run project -> task -> session -> timeline/trace/evidence -> detail and assert mount receives host-redacted ViewModel/state while ProductSessionId stays public.
verification.profile_restart: Synchronize the changed client/package into the DSH web profile with cp or pnpm install, restart DSH, then force-refresh the browser; verify the plugin loads and stale client behavior is absent.
verification.browser_acceptance: From the sidebar enter UniClaw Workspace, select a task, observe request -> decision -> result, switch DSH Trace/UniClaw Trace/Metadata/Evidence, open detail, and verify structured RPC failure plus uncorrelated mapping are visible.
